sentences.text:
Date : 29-01-2019 This is an application, made under Section 439 Cr.P.C., seeking bail by the accused-petitioner, namely, Rahul Das, in connection with Noonmati Police Station Case No.
797/2018 (Corresponding to GR No.19218/2018), registered under Sections 273/284/420 of the IPC, read with Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
I have perused the petition including the annexures furnished therewith.

Heard Mr. P Borah,
learned counsel appearing for the accused-petitioner and Mr. NK Kalita, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, appearing for the State.

The accused-petitioner was arrested on 29-12-2018 and as such,
he has been in custody for 32 days as of Page No.# 2/2 now.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the offence alleged and the period of detention, this Court is of the view that further custodial detention of the accused-petitioner is not necessary.

Accordingly, the accused-petitioner, named above, shall be released on bail in connection with the case aforementioned on furnishing bail bond of Rs.2,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount,
to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kamrup(M), Guwahati.
In terms of the above, this bail application stands disposed of.
